summary.rule_observed: Each source card TextExtra describes when friendly remaining LP is at least 1, reduce friendly LP by 1, then replace one named friendly backfield terrain with a named replacement terrain.

common_rule.selection: specific named terrain stated per card
common_rule.replacement: specific named terrain stated per card

test_matrix: LP=1: verify cost/payment and resulting LP=0 behavior.
LP=0: condition fails; verify no terrain change and no LP payment.
named source terrain absent: verify failure/skip behavior.
multiple named source terrains: verify exact slot selection.
replace source terrain: verify slot and card state/counters/attached effects.
3-counter start, activation decrement, depletion, and reset timing.
TextBase/TextExtra area-name discrepancy: retain both exact spellings; determine alias only from source or engine.
